zh.title: 美國聯邦航空總署要求空中巴士A380更換發動機零件
zh.summary: 美國聯邦航空總署下令拆除15具高壓渦輪級間封嚴；期限緊迫、每具發動機費用達六位數
body: Simple Flying報導，美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）下令空中巴士A380進行發動機更換作業。
報導指出，這項命令要求拆除15具高壓渦輪級間封嚴，並訂有緊迫的期限。
Simple Flying的摘要並提到，每具發動機的相關費用達六位數。
Simple Flying的標題指出，這項命令是在一起非包容性失效導致中止起飛之後發布。
目前可取得的資訊僅限於Simple Flying的標題與摘要，未包含涉事航空公司、機場、日期或失效原因的進一步細節。

en.title: FAA orders Airbus A380 engine part removals after uncontained failure aborted takeoff
en.summary: FAA mandates removal of 15 high pressure turbine interstage seals; tight deadlines; six-figure per-engine costs
body: Simple Flying reports that the FAA has ordered Airbus A380 engine replacements.
According to the report, the order mandates the removal of 15 high pressure turbine interstage seals with tight deadlines.
The report's summary states the costs reach six figures per engine.
Simple Flying's headline says the order follows an uncontained failure that forced an aborted takeoff.
The available material is limited to Simple Flying's headline and summary; it does not name an airline, airport, date or stated cause.

zh.title: Joby要求法院推翻Aerosonic近1.17億美元陪審團裁決
zh.summary: Joby要求法院推翻近1.17億美元裁決，案件尚未作成最終判決
body: Joby Aviation已向聯邦法院請求推翻陪審團判給Aerosonic近1.17億美元的裁決。Joby表示，公司自行開發飛機感測器，並未挪用供應商的商業機密。陪審團於2026年10月2日在佛羅裏達州坦帕認定Joby違反保密協議並侵佔Aerosonic的商業機密；該裁決尚非最終判決。
陪審團就違反保密協議及不當使用商業機密判給Aerosonic損害賠償，並在認定相關行為「蓄意且惡意」後另判懲罰性賠償。Joby表示，多年來自行設計並製造其空氣資料系統，並將進一步提出法律挑戰，必要時包括上訴。Aerosonic製造的探針可測量飛機周圍的氣壓，相關資料用於計算空速、高度及攻角。

en.title: Joby asks court to overturn nearly $117 million Aerosonic jury award
en.summary: Joby asks a court to overturn Aerosonic’s nearly $117 million jury award; the verdict is not final.
body: Joby Aviation has asked a federal court to overturn a nearly $117 million jury award to Aerosonic, saying it developed its aircraft sensors without misusing the supplier’s trade secrets. A jury in Tampa, Florida, found on October 2, 2026, that Joby breached a confidentiality agreement and misappropriated Aerosonic’s trade secrets. The verdict is not yet a final judgment.

The jury awarded Aerosonic damages for the agreement breach and trade-secret misuse, plus punitive damages after finding the misappropriation “willful and malicious.” Joby said it spent years engineering and manufacturing its air data system and would pursue further court challenges, including an appeal if necessary. Aerosonic makes probes that measure air pressure around an aircraft; the data is used to calculate airspeed, altitude and angle of attack.
